item.title: Fifteen in Fifteen – October 7, 2026
item.description:
Fifteen in Fifteen – October 7, 2026
• Israel marks three years since October 7 (sources: The Times of Israel, Haaretz) • Security warning for the anniversary (sources: The Times of Israel, i24NEWS) • Gaza: strikes continue, UN calls for a permanent ceasefire (sources: Qatar News Agency, The Times of Israel, The Jerusalem Post) • Israel's election: a race that's too close to call (sources: Haaretz, The Jerusalem Post) • Haredi protesters block a draft-dodger arrest (sources: The Times of Israel, Haaretz) • Flydubai cockpit attack on a flight to Tel Aviv (sources: Euronews, Al Jazeera, The Times of Israel) • Zelensky hosts an Israeli delegation in Kyiv (sources: The Times of Israel, 112 Ukraine) • Trump's 'take out Los Angeles' remark draws backlash (sources: Axios, NBC News, FactCheck.org) • Trump approves firing squad for Fort Hood shooter (sources: The Washington Post, CNBC, Al Jazeera) • Wall Street hits a record as oil eases (sources: TheStreet, Bloomberg, Yahoo Finance) • Paramount's merger with Warner Bros. Discovery closes (sources: Deadline, The Hill, NBC Los Angeles) • Trump announces $90 Medicare payments for seniors (sources: CNN, NBC News, The White House) • Okinawa: curfew and alcohol ban for U.S. forces after murder case (sources: Reuters via U.S. News, Bangkok Post) • Jeffrey Archer, novelist and former politician, dies at 86 (sources: The Irish Times, ITV News) • Nobel Prize in Physics goes to Francis Halzen for ghost particles (sources: NobelPrize.org, CNN, Al Jazeera)
Script and voice are AI-generated. Details may change as stories develop. Commentary is opinion.
